name: zweapon_load_opt_catalog_from_path
description: zWeapon::LoadOptCatalogFromPath loads weapons.zrd, validates the version, builds the OptCatalog entry table, initializes runtime projectile storage, and installs the OptCatalog runtime tick callback.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a coherent zWeapon/OptCatalog source-cluster pass.
The loader is intentionally accepted on the functional-verification mode because /Ob1-era inlining and class/source-cluster context are expected to affect isolated byte shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b1190 validates the fastcall ABI, thermal-glow pool initialization, zReader::LoadNodeFromPath, VERSION == 2 gate, warning-sample globals, MAX_CRATER_RADIUS, BALLISTICS entry table allocation, per-entry defaults and parsed fields, embedded FIRE/FLYOUT/IMPACT FX specs, timed-status blocks, runtime projectile pool setup, callback node priority/action callback installation, network option state storage, and success/error return values.

The native smoke builds a minimal weapons.zrd archive, calls zWeapon::LoadOptCatalogFromPath, verifies the loaded root/world/network globals, entry callback, recovered entry strings and numeric fields, crater/timed-status data, runtime instance count, and projectile pool allocation.
